name: @zavon/console-ui
description: The console's board: steps as fitted lanes with no scrollbars (fade edges, an "N more" chip, a ruled header with the true total), ten cards a lane with a keyset cursor each, a Board/List toggle, filters in the URL, the Move dialog (back only through it, with a reason, admin only; skips confirmed; frequent moves warned), bulk moves one column at a time, and rule chips. Held to the vectors in contract/boardquery.
